deep.reconstruction: This page has no mathematics. It is the blue paper wrapper or cover of the bundle, and it is otherwise blank. In the upper left corner there are five faint pencil lines. Each has a number on the left (read as 25, 25, 25, 14 or 14.5, 14) and a date in day.month.year form on the right. The legible dates are 22.3.77 and 17.10.79, and the others look like dates from the late 1870s or around 1880. Riemann died in 1866, so these notes are not in his hand. They are almost certainly later archival, library or editorial bookkeeping, perhaps loan or consultation records or sheet counts, from the period when Dedekind and Weber were preparing the Gesammelte Werke (1876, Nachträge later). The numbers could be sheet or folio counts, or call or lending references, recorded each time the bundle was used. There is nothing to reconstruct mathematically. The next image is the color and scale calibration card (QPCARD 201) from the digitization by SUB Göttingen/GDZ, so this page sits at the boundary of the bundle.
